findings.title: source-time guard spawns `git` in the self-hosted root, ahead of the unattended-trust gate (`orchid_root_stale`'s content check runs `git -C $ORCHID_ROOT diff --cached` whenever the root is parked on the integration branch — exactly when `$ORCHID_ROOT` *is* the managed repo, so the comment's "orchid's own installation, never a repository a run was merely pointed at" does not hold in the only case it fires; `tests/test_unattended_trust.sh:104`'s "no git before an acknowledgement" fence passes only because `$REPO_ROOT` happens not to be on that branch, and fails if the suite is run from the integration checkout)
